descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S08 「已存数据 × 部分，两个模式：出院任务和等待中的结果决定哪些部分有内容；point 填进 Active Issues」 Stored data × section, both contexts: discharge task and awaited result decide which sections fill; the point fills Active Issues

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 Sections populate only from stored data: an empty section stays empty (no discharge barrier invented when no discharge task exists, no invented pending result), and nothing in the handoff is invented …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 5；UAT 3.4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U2 Each patient's handoff has four sections: active issues, discharge barriers, pending results, to-do/if-then.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U3 Hospital and Nursing Home use the same handoff structure and delivery; there is no separate Nursing Home format (and no data from the other context).（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 3；UAT 3.3；UAT TC-21） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Four Hospital patients and four Nursing Home residents, each set a 2×2 table (discharge task yes/no × awaited result yes/no), each with one important point

When Generate each handoff through the app's own path

Then Discharge barriers is filled only where a discharge task exists; pending results only where an awaited result exists; the if-then task lands in to-do/if-then; each important point lands in active issues; the other sections stay empty, in both contexts

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Per patient: sectionIncludes and emptySections as in spec (AC 5's own example), for 'rounding' and 'snf' (3.3). Empty = an empty list in the result; how an empty section is shown on screen is Q2

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
